@'

describe("CUE4Parse panel inputs (T0281)", () => {
  const cue = { id: "cue4parse", mode: "headless", status: "ready" } as never;
  const form = {
    input: "D:/Archives", outputDir: "D:/Converted", attested: true,
    ueVersion: " GAME_UE5_7 ", assets: " /Game/Meshes/Cube.Cube \n/Game/Textures/Grid.Grid\n",
    mappings: " D:/Mappings/game.usmap ", aesKeyEnv: " GAME_AES_KEY ",
  };

  it("sends all four trimmed CUE4Parse fields with line-separated object selections", () => {
    expect(converterRunProblem(cue, form)).toBeNull();
    expect(converterRequest(cue, form)).toEqual({
      converterId: "cue4parse", rightsAttested: true, input: "D:/Archives", outputDir: "D:/Converted",
      ueVersion: "GAME_UE5_7", assets: ["/Game/Meshes/Cube.Cube", "/Game/Textures/Grid.Grid"],
      mappings: "D:/Mappings/game.usmap", aesKeyEnv: "GAME_AES_KEY",
    });
  });

  it("omits blank optional mappings/key name and accepts CRLF selections", () => {
    const optional = { ...form, assets: "Game/Cube.Cube\r\n\r\n /Game/Grid.Grid ", mappings: " ", aesKeyEnv: " " };
    expect(converterRunProblem(cue, optional)).toBeNull();
    expect(converterRequest(cue, optional)).toEqual({
      converterId: "cue4parse", rightsAttested: true, input: "D:/Archives", outputDir: "D:/Converted",
      ueVersion: "GAME_UE5_7", assets: ["Game/Cube.Cube", "/Game/Grid.Grid"],
    });
  });

  it.each(["", "5.7", "GAME_UE5_7;cmd", `GAME_${"a".repeat(129)}`])("refuses invalid version %s", (ueVersion) => {
    expect(converterRunProblem(cue, { ...form, ueVersion })).toMatch(/version|EGame/i);
  });
  it.each(["", "/Game/../Cube.Cube", "D:/Cube.uasset", "/Game/Cube", "/Game/Cube.Cube\n/game/cube.cube", "a".repeat(4097), Array(1001).fill("/Game/Cube.Cube").join("\n")])("refuses invalid or duplicate selections %#", (assets) => {
    expect(converterRunProblem(cue, { ...form, assets })).toMatch(/asset|object/i);
  });
  it.each(["relative.usmap", "D:relative.usmap", "D:/Mappings/game.txt"])("refuses invalid mappings %s", (mappings) => {
    expect(converterRunProblem(cue, { ...form, mappings })).toMatch(/usmap/i);
  });
  it.each([`0x${"a".repeat(64)}`, "1BAD_NAME", "KEY=value", "KEY NAME", "a".repeat(129)])("refuses literal/invalid AES name %# without echoing it", (aesKeyEnv) => {
    const problem = converterRunProblem(cue, { ...form, aesKeyEnv });
    expect(problem).toMatch(/environment variable NAME/i);
    expect(problem).not.toContain(aesKeyEnv);
    expect(() => converterRequest(cue, { ...form, aesKeyEnv })).toThrow(/environment variable NAME/i);
  });

  it("keeps rights/setup gates first and other converter requests unchanged", () => {
    expect(converterRunProblem(cue, { ...form, attested: false, ueVersion: "" })).toMatch(/rights/i);
    expect(converterRunProblem({ id: "cue4parse", mode: "headless", status: "needs-setup" } as never, form)).toMatch(/set.*up/i);
    expect(converterRequest({ id: "unitypy", mode: "headless" } as never, form)).toEqual({
      converterId: "unitypy", rightsAttested: true, input: "D:/Archives", outputDir: "D:/Converted",
    });
    expect(converterRequest({ id: "fmodel-cue4parse", mode: "launch" } as never, form)).toEqual({
      converterId: "fmodel-cue4parse", rightsAttested: true,
    });
  });
});
'@ | Add-Content apps/web/src/litesuite/components/panels/game-director/gameDirectorLogic.test.ts
@'

describe("Game Director wizard: CUE4Parse inputs (T0281)", () => {
  let run: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  beforeEach(() => {
    run = vi.fn(async (): Promise<ConverterRunResult> => ({
      ok: true, mode: "headless", outputs: ["D:/Converted/cube.glb"], log: [], error: null,
    }));
    installBridge(makeBridge({
      converters: vi.fn(async () => [...CONVERTERS_WITH_MODES, {
        ...CONVERTERS[0]!, id: "cue4parse", name: "CUE4Parse", mode: "headless" as const, status: "ready" as const,
      }]),
      runConverter: run as unknown as GameDirectorApi["runConverter"],
    }));
  });
  async function openCue() {
    await walkToAddons();
    click("converter-toggle-cue4parse");
    await waitFor(() => expect(q("converter-form-cue4parse")).not.toBeNull());
    await fill("converter-input-cue4parse", "D:/Archives");
    await fill("converter-output-cue4parse", "D:/Converted");
  }
  const submit = () => q("converter-submit-cue4parse") as HTMLButtonElement;

  it("carries all four fields over IPC and resets the rights tick for the next run", async () => {
    await openCue();
    await fill("converter-version-cue4parse", " GAME_UE5_7 ");
    await fill("converter-assets-cue4parse", " /Game/Meshes/Cube.Cube \n/Game/Textures/Grid.Grid ");
    await fill("converter-mappings-cue4parse", " D:/Mappings/game.usmap ");
    await fill("converter-aes-env-cue4parse", " GAME_AES_KEY ");
    expect(submit().disabled).toBe(true);
    submit().click();
    expect(run).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    click("converter-attest-cue4parse");
    await waitFor(() => expect(submit().disabled).toBe(false));
    submit().click();
    await waitFor(() => expect(run).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(run).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      converterId: "cue4parse", rightsAttested: true, input: "D:/Archives", outputDir: "D:/Converted",
      ueVersion: "GAME_UE5_7", assets: ["/Game/Meshes/Cube.Cube", "/Game/Textures/Grid.Grid"],
      mappings: "D:/Mappings/game.usmap", aesKeyEnv: "GAME_AES_KEY",
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(text("converter-output-file-cue4parse")).toBe("D:/Converted/cube.glb"));
    expect((q("converter-attest-cue4parse") as HTMLInputElement).checked).toBe(false);
    expect(submit().disabled).toBe(true);
  });

  it("refuses a literal AES value before IPC, then accepts a NAME", async () => {
    await openCue();
    await fill("converter-version-cue4parse", "GAME_UE5_7");
    await fill("converter-assets-cue4parse", "/Game/Cube.Cube");
    const literal = `0x${"a".repeat(64)}`;
    await fill("converter-aes-env-cue4parse", literal);
    click("converter-attest-cue4parse");
    await waitFor(() => expect(text("converter-problem-cue4parse")).toMatch(/environment variable NAME/i));
    expect(text("converter-problem-cue4parse")).not.toContain(literal);
    expect(submit().disabled).toBe(true);
    submit().click();
    expect(run).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await fill("converter-aes-env-cue4parse", "GAME_AES_KEY");
    await waitFor(() => expect(submit().disabled).toBe(false));
    submit().click();
    await waitFor(() => expect(run).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(run.mock.calls[0]![0].aesKeyEnv).toBe("GAME_AES_KEY");
    expect(run.mock.calls[0]![0]).not.toHaveProperty("mappings");
  });

  it("requires version/unique object paths and never shows CUE fields on UnityPy/GUI rows", async () => {
    await openCue();
    click("converter-attest-cue4parse");
    await waitFor(() => expect(text("converter-problem-cue4parse")).toMatch(/version|EGame/i));
    await fill("converter-version-cue4parse", "GAME_UE5_7");
    await fill("converter-assets-cue4parse", "/Game/Cube.Cube\n/game/cube.cube");
    await waitFor(() => expect(text("converter-problem-cue4parse")).toMatch(/unique/i));
    expect(submit().disabled).toBe(true);
    submit().click();
    expect(run).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    for (const id of ["unitypy", "fmodel-cue4parse"]) {
      click(`converter-toggle-${id}`);
      await waitFor(() => expect(q(`converter-form-${id}`)).not.toBeNull());
      for (const field of ["version", "assets", "mappings", "aes-env"]) expect(q(`converter-${field}-${id}`)).toBeNull();
    }
  });
});
